headline: Mirza Fakhrul to take oath as 23rd President Friday evening
summary: The President-elect will visit the graves of Ziaur Rahman and Khaleda Zia before the swearing-in ceremony at Bangabhaban.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is set to take the oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Friday evening at Bangabhaban.
Before the ceremony, he will visit the graves of former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia at Zia Uddyan in Dhaka after Jummah prayers.

caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir becomes the 23rd President of Bangladesh.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is set to take the oath as the 23rd President of Bangladesh on Friday evening at Bangabhaban.

Before the ceremony, he will visit the graves of former President Ziaur Rahman and former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia at Zia Uddyan in Dhaka after Jummah prayers.

During the visit, the President-elect will offer prayers and Fatiha at the gravesites.

Mirza Fakhrul was elected as President on Thursday, August 20, by the members of Parliament. He received 255 votes out of a total of 349 votes cast.

headline_marked: [[Islami Jubo Andolan leader killed]] in Narayanganj gang attack
headline: Islami Jubo Andolan leader killed in Narayanganj gang attack
summary: The victim had previously filed a case against the attackers after his rickshaw garage was looted during the student protests in August.
details: Mujahidul Islam, alias Bulbul, a local leader of Islami Jubo Andolan, was hacked to death in the Saleh Nagar area of Narayanganj on Thursday night.
The 45-year-old victim served as the Law and Human Rights Secretary for the Bandar police station branch of the organization.
According to family members, Mujahidul had been active in the anti-discrimination student movement in August 2024, which led to his rickshaw garage being looted and 18 rickshaws stolen.
Following the loot, Mujahidul filed a case on August 20 against several individuals, including Sheikh Sifat. He was allegedly pressured and threatened with death to withdraw the case.
Attackers surrounded Mujahidul while he was alone and hacked him with sharp weapons before fleeing. He was declared dead upon arrival at Narayanganj General Hospital.
In protest, Islami Andolan activists blocked the Dhaka-Chattogram highway at Madanpur on Friday morning, causing significant traffic congestion for about half an hour.
Protesters also reportedly attacked and set fire to the house of the accused, Sheikh Sifat, and his relatives before police deployed additional forces to control the situation.
Police have arrested Sheikh Sifat and are continuing investigations to identify other suspects. A formal case regarding the murder is being prepared.
caption:
A local leader of Islami Jubo Andolan was hacked to death in Narayanganj after filing a case against those who looted his business.

Mujahidul Islam, alias Bulbul, a local leader of Islami Jubo Andolan, was hacked to death in the Saleh Nagar area of Narayanganj on Thursday night.

The 45-year-old victim served as the Law and Human Rights Secretary for the Bandar police station branch of the organization.

According to family members, Mujahidul had been active in the anti-discrimination student movement in August 2024, which led to his rickshaw garage being looted and 18 rickshaws stolen.

Following the loot, Mujahidul filed a case on August 20 against several individuals, including Sheikh Sifat. He was allegedly pressured and threatened with death to withdraw the case.

Attackers surrounded Mujahidul while he was alone and hacked him with sharp weapons before fleeing. He was declared dead upon arrival at Narayanganj General Hospital.

In protest, Islami Andolan activists blocked the Dhaka-Chattogram highway at Madanpur on Friday morning, causing significant traffic congestion for about half an hour.

Protesters also reportedly attacked and set fire to the house of the accused, Sheikh Sifat, and his relatives before police deployed additional forces to control the situation.

Police have arrested Sheikh Sifat and are continuing investigations to identify other suspects. A formal case regarding the murder is being prepared.
